title: Workflow
description: One recurring document, defined once: trigger -> gather -> diff -> write -> gate -> land -> brief -> record. Harness-neutral. Company-specific values live in config and in connectors.json, never in the workflow body. A run is complete only when the done-means contract holds in its run directory.

kind.description: writer produces a document through a skill and a gate; consumer reads other workflows' ledgers; collector only fills a cache

component.description: partition this workflow belongs to; the private one (default 'hr') keeps people data apart

workspace.description: required for the private component: the folder and memory partition the cell runs in

agent.description: agent template for harnesses that take one (Kiro CLI: the template gen-agent emits)

events.description: event descriptions a heartbeat watches for, e.g. 'calendar item <Name> : <Me> | 1 on 1 minus 1 day'

connector.description: namespaced connector name, e.g. docs.read, chat.search; resolved through connectors.json

ref.description: locator for the connector (doc id, channel, query); may use ${config.x}

extra_checklists.description: files the gate reads and scores besides its own checklist (an organisation's writing style). Each must exist once ${instance} is expanded. <instance>/gate-policy.json required_extra_checklists lists the ones every writer must carry

second_opinion.description: after the gate, an independent critic on this harness evaluates draft.md against the evidence; findings are recorded in meta.json, they never edit or block

style_rules.description: rules JSON for scripts/style-check.py (the countable style checks: sentence length, weasel words, unexpanded acronyms, dates with no year, ISO dates, URL-as-label links, semicolons, em-dashes, hedge words, marker form, comparatives without a number, from-X-to-Y spans without the relative change, a marker used as a verb or bare, unclosed brackets in a cell, a space before punctuation). Default: <instance>/gate-policy.json required_style_rules. When the policy names one, a writer may not set this to false or to another file (vstack check fails it)

coverage.description: source coverage a writer workflow must meet; check fails otherwise

require_connectors.description: connectors that must appear among sources, e.g. a corroboration connector

brief.description: optional: where the three-line brief.md goes besides the run dir

draft_contract.description: optional shape rules for draft.md, enforced by verify_contract after every run and printed into the prompt's Done-means block. A template contract that lives only in a context file is remembered; one listed here is enforced: a miss marks the run contract_unmet. Use it for the parts of a document a reader has corrected once already (table headers, column names, banned wording).

pattern.description: Python regex, multiline; must hit at least once in draft.md

why.description: the correction this rule encodes, with its date

pattern.description: Python regex, multiline; must not hit anywhere in draft.md

bot.description: the Kiro Crew bot (memory partition) that should host this workflow; bound on the Schedule page, printed by gen-cron

sample_evidence.description: sample evidence used by --dry-run, relative to the workflow file. Default: <workflow>.sample.json beside it
